items.text: X-rays pass easily through soft body tissue but cannot pass through bones.As aresult,radiographs orx-raypictures can be taken to check a patient'sbones.

items.label: text
items.text: Working with x-rays can cause cancer.Radiographers,who take x-rays,are at riskandhave tostand behind lead screens orwearprotective clothing.

items.text: Gamma rays,like x-rays,are highly penetrating rays and can cause damage toliving cells.The damage can cause mutations (negative changes),which can lead to cancer.They are used to sterilise medical instruments,to kill microorganismsso thatfoodwill keepfor longer and totreatcancerusing radiotherapy.Gamma rays can both cause and cure cancer.Large doses of gamma rays targeted directly at the cancerous growth can be used tokill the cancer cells completely.
